@zoe From my handover notes: candidates with equal scores keep the order in which they were supplied (editors list preferred tags first); ties must NOT be re-sorted alphabetically or by length. So for rank_matches("cat", ["hat", "bat", "cut", "cat"]) the order is ("cat",1.0), ("hat",0.67), ("bat",0.67), ("cut",0.67) — input order preserved for ties. That means test_ties_and_duplicates is correct; test_regression_issue_519 is the one that's wrong.
